<!-- Yandex Music pull request template -->
## Description

<!-- What does this PR do? Why is it needed? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/Infrastructure
- [ ] Refactoring

## Testing

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`uv run pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] New/changed code is covered by tests

## Release hygiene

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for the next version
- [ ] `VERSION` is untouched (maintainer bumps it at release time)
- [ ] For a `feat:` change, a spec exists under `specs/` (or the PR body explains why none is needed)

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] I can explain every change in this PR in my own words
